error_taxonomy.SARCASM_CONFUSED_WITH_PA: Sarcasm without interpersonal hostility misclassified as passive aggression.
error_taxonomy.SUBTLE_WORDING_MISSED: Passive aggression overlooked due to understated, polite, or veiled wording.
error_taxonomy.DIRECT_OVERT_AGGRESSION_CONFUSED: Overt hostility or direct toxicity confused with covert passive aggression.
error_taxonomy.GENUINE_PRAISE_MISCLASSIFIED: Sincere appreciation or compliments incorrectly flagged as backhanded.
error_taxonomy.IMAGE_COMMENT_MISMATCH: Visual scene incongruity incorrectly biasing text interpretation.
error_taxonomy.OCR_FAILURE_OR_ABSENT: Inability to read text embedded within images obscuring meaning.
error_taxonomy.MISSING_CONTEXT: Absence of dialogue history leading to ambiguous interpretation.
error_taxonomy.AMBIGUOUS_UNCERTAINTY: Model prediction exhibits near-uniform uncertainty across classes.
